items.q: Dave Bailey, Duck Ernest, Forstaff, Cornette player was a dude Foster's brother... Then after Foster, he got into the band too

ctx.x: Dave Bailey, Duck Ernest, Forstaff, Cornette player was a dude Foster's brother Foster's brother Foster's brother yeah Then after Foster, he got into the band too Yeah so that's why they used to go and They had a nice little band Then after they put Dude out And they took Wesley Dime He the one that got killed in Baton-Lewis He was a nice little corner of that band And then Blind Freddy too Used to play in there Don't care why you tell him me that he could meet there And he had no eyes at all but he could play…
But could he uh... How did he compare with Blind Freddy with the best clarinet players for head?
